task:
Add referral handling to rightnow-ai: create or link a referral lead when an inbound reply points to a colleague or says the lead is the wrong person.

Create packages/core/src/mail/referral.ts with pure extractReferrals({ text, cc, category, leadEmail, own }) -> { emails: string[]; needsTask: boolean }. It runs only when category is "WRONG_PERSON" or the unquoted body contains a referral phrase (cc'ing, copying, please contact, not the right person, left the company). Candidates come from cc plus body addresses within 120 characters of a phrase. Reject addresses outside the lead's company domain (free-mail leads cannot refer), the lead itself, own addresses (case-insensitive), role mailboxes and duplicates; keep at most three. needsTask is true only for WRONG_PERSON with no addresses.

Add applyReferrals(tx, clock, ws, message, lead, category) there: skip suppressed emails; create a lead with source "referral", tags ["referral"], labels [], inheriting company/website/industry/country/region/lawful basis/owner, or link an existing lead only when its referredById is null. Do not campaign-enrol referrals. A wrong person with no address gets a task titled "Find the right contact for this referral", due in 24 hours for its owner.

Add referredById and a SetNull self-relation to the Lead model. In packages/core/src/leads/service.ts: getLead includes referredBy {id, email} only for a live same-workspace lead, else null; mergeLeads repoints referrals, avoids self-reference and inherits a safe referrer; gdprDeleteLead clears links to the deleted lead. Call applyReferrals from packages/core/src/mail/stoprules.ts for fresh replies in a savepoint, so failures leave reply handling committed and audit referral.hook_failed.

Add or update tests for the new behavior.
test_command: npm run db:generate && npx vitest run packages/core/test/leads.test.ts packages/core/test/referral.test.ts packages/core/test/stoprules.test.ts --reporter=junit --outputFile=.bench-junit/hidden.xml
suite_command: npm run db:generate && npx vitest run packages/core --reporter=junit --outputFile=.bench-junit/suite.xml
